title: Bad Bunny Plays Warsaw's PGE Narodowy — Poland Tour Debut
detail: Bad Bunny plays his first-ever Poland show at PGE Narodowy in Warsaw (July 14, 2026), with 'La Zona' as the night's exclusive song. The show continues the tour's final stretch, with Milan (July 17–18) and the Brussels finale (July 22) remaining.
